incidents.target_subsystem: ezEngine ColonyPlugin - Module 78 (Alien Xenobiology & Pheromonal Swarm Broods)
raw_compiler_output: checkpoint: kinetic railgun interception and drop pod vaporization in upper atmosphere ok
Larva failed to pupate through Cocoon to AdultWarrior
incidents.triage_diagnosis:
Root Cause: In ColonyXenobiologySystem::Update(), stage transitions were executed using a single switch statement per tick. When a large delta time (e.g. 8.2s covering two incubation cycles) was passed, the progress was reset to 0.0 upon reaching Cocoon, losing leftover accumulated delta progress and preventing the specimen from completing pupation to AdultWarrior in that step.

Minimal Repair:
1. Replace the single-switch block with a while (sp.m_fIncubationProgress >= 1.0f) cascade.
2. Deduct 1.0f per transition (m_fIncubationProgress -= 1.0f) so large delta times cascade cleanly across sequential pupation metamorphosis stages.

incidents.root_cause: When updating pod flight progress in InFlightSubOrbital state, transitioning into AtmosphericReentry triggered within the 'if' block prevented the subsequent 'else if' branch from executing during the same tick. Consequently, thermal ablation of the heat shield did not commence until the subsequent tick, causing assertion failure in checkpoint 255.
incidents.resolution: Immediately apply fractional thermal ablation proportional to the flight time elapsed since crossing the reentry threshold upon transitioning into ezColonyPodStatus::AtmosphericReentry within the update cycle.
incidents.preventative_guideline: When state machine transitions occur inside tick update branches, either allow fall-through to the newly entered state or immediately evaluate entering-edge dynamics to prevent single-frame latency glitches.

incidents.trigger: Gate 3 / 5090 Blackwell Code Review Failure (STATUS: REJECT)
raw_compiler_output: - Point 1: ColonyHospitalitySystem allocates ezDynamicArray in constructor and uses heap reallocations.
- Point 2: Bed indices use unchecked array indexing without runtime bounds validation.
incidents.triage_diagnosis:
Root Cause: High-performance simulation systems must enforce zero-allocation semantics on bounded domains. Using ezDynamicArray introduces malloc/free cycles. Array access lacked production bounds validation.

Minimal Repair:
Migrate to ezStaticArray<T, N> with EZ_ASSERT_ALWAYS bounds checks and provide non-throwing TryGetBed() accessors.
incidents.learned_invariant: SKILL-008: In hot subsystems with bounded domains, use ezStaticArray to ensure zero heap allocations, enforce bounds via EZ_ASSERT_ALWAYS, and provide non-throwing TryGet accessors.

raw_compiler_output: checkpoint: smooth wall engraving quality and subject selection ok
checkpoint: engraving observation beauty and colonist legend mood buff ok
Patient failed to enter SurgicalPlanes anesthesia or pain suppression failed
incidents.triage_diagnosis:
Root Cause: In ColonyPharmacologySystem::Update(), state evaluation was positioned before metabolic drug clearance. The 4.0-second metabolism decay reduced drug concentration from 0.935 to 0.735, but the stage machine reflected the prior frame's ParalyzedOverdose value until the subsequent update cycle. Additionally, pain suppression decay was being applied unconditionally even while patients remained in SurgicalPlanes.

Minimal Repair:
1. Move hepatic & renal metabolic clearance before stage classification.
2. In SurgicalPlanes and ParalyzedOverdose, lock pain suppression to 1.0f (complete analgesic anesthesia).
3. Only decay pain suppression when anesthesia stage drops below SurgicalPlanes.

incidents.trigger: CMake / MSVC C++20 Native Compilation Failure
incidents.triage_diagnosis:
Root Cause: ezEngine does not define an 'ezFloat32' type alias in Foundation/Types/Types.h. While integer primitives are aliased (ezInt32, ezUInt32), single-precision floats use standard 'float'.

Minimal Repair:
Replace all occurrences of 'ezFloat32' with 'float' in ColonyBallisticsSystem.h and ColonyBallisticsSystem.cpp.
incidents.learned_invariant: SKILL-009: In ezEngine, floating-point primitive types are standard 'float' and 'double'. There are no 'ezFloat32' or 'ezFloat64' aliases in Foundation/Types/Types.h.

incidents.title: MSVC C2447 / C2825 syntax error caused by misspelled export macro EZ_COLONY_PLUGIN_DLL
incidents.description: During compilation of Modules 94 and 95, MSVC failed with C2447 ('{': missing function header) and C2825 ('left of :: must be a class/struct/union').
incidents.root_cause: The export macro in ColonyPluginDLL.h is defined as EZ_COLONYPLUGIN_DLL (no underscore between COLONY and PLUGIN). The new headers defined classes using EZ_COLONY_PLUGIN_DLL, which was undefined and led the compiler to parse subsequent tokens as malformed expressions.
incidents.resolution: Applied search-and-replace to update EZ_COLONY_PLUGIN_DLL to EZ_COLONYPLUGIN_DLL in ColonyFungalSporeSystem.h and ColonyOrbitalLaserShieldSystem.h. Full compilation succeeded cleanly with 0 warnings.

incidents.trigger: CMake / MSVC C++20 Native Compilation Failure
raw_compiler_output: C:\Users\5216p\ezEngine\Code\EnginePlugins\ColonyPlugin\ColonyWeatherSystem.h(15,8): error C2371: 'ezColonyRoomMap': redefinition; different basic types
C:\Users\5216p\ezEngine\Code\EnginePlugins\ColonyPlugin\ColonyRoomRoleSystem.cpp(84,33): error C2039: 'm_RoomIndexPerCell': is not a member of 'ezColonyRoomMap'
incidents.triage_diagnosis:
Root Cause: ColonyRoomComponent.h includes ColonyWorldModule.h, while ColonyWorldModule.h includes ColonyRoomComponent.h, causing an incomplete type cycle. Additionally, ColonyWeatherSystem.h forward declared 'class ezColonyRoomMap' when the type is defined as 'struct ezColonyRoomMap'. In RegenerateAllRooms, ezDynamicArray::SetCount does not reinitialize elements if capacity equals total cells.

Minimal Repair:
1. Replace #include <ColonyPlugin/ColonyWorldModule.h> in ColonyRoomComponent.h with 'class ezColonyWorldModule;' and 'struct ezColonyCell;'.
2. Align forward declaration in ColonyWeatherSystem.h to 'struct ezColonyRoomMap;'.
3. Add 'ref_map.m_RoomIndexPerCell.Clear();' before SetCount in RegenerateAllRooms.

incidents.target_subsystem: ezEngine ColonyPlugin - Module 53 (Deep Anomaly & Void Containment)
incidents.trigger: CMake / MSVC C++20 Native Compilation Failure
raw_compiler_output: C:\Users\5216p\ezEngine\Code\EnginePlugins\ColonyPlugin\Test\ColonyPluginTest.cpp(5214,1): fatal error C2601: 'TestAnomalyContainment': a local function definition is illegal
incidents.triage_diagnosis:
Root Cause: The autonomous code synthesis defined a named helper function 'void TestAnomalyContainment()' directly inside the body of the enclosing 'RunChecks()' test function. In MSVC C++20, nested function definitions are illegal (C2601).

Minimal Repair:
Flatten the test logic directly into the enclosing function scope or wrap inside an anonymous block '{ ... }' with local lambdas.
incidents.learned_invariant: SKILL-006: In C++20, define test logic directly within the enclosing function scope or use local lambdas to avoid illegal nested function definitions (C2601).

incidents.target_subsystem: ezEngine ColonyPlugin - Module 74 (Geothermal Steam Well Venting & Seismology)
raw_compiler_output: checkpoint: cave moss grazing trophic cycle and fungal wood harvest ok
Geothermal vent failed to reach superheated eruption thermodynamic profile
incidents.triage_diagnosis:
Root Cause: In ColonyGeothermalSystem::Update(), when phase timer crossed PreEruptionDurationSec, the phase switch transitioned vent.m_Phase to Erupting without immediately initializing the peak thermodynamic state variables (temperature 350C, pressure 1200 kPa, steam output 25 kg/s). Because the switch block had already completed for that update tick, callers interrogating the vent within the same frame saw PreEruption residual values until the subsequent tick.

Minimal Repair:
1. Initialize eruption thermodynamics immediately upon state transition inside the timer boundary.
2. Similarly initialize baseline dormant thermodynamics immediately when transitioning out of cooling.

incidents.target_subsystem: ezEngine ColonyPlugin - Module 113 (Deep Crust Geothermal Fracturing & Superheated Brine Desalination)
incidents.failure_signature: Overpressure fracture injection failed to trigger catastrophic casing collapse
incidents.root_cause_analysis: In ezColonyGeothermalDesalinationSystem::Update, when induced seismic stress rapidly climbed from 40% to 100% in a single timestep, the code evaluated 'if (stress >= MAX_SAFE_SEISMIC_STRESS_PERCENT)' (80%) first and transitioned the state to InducedSeismicTremorWarning. The 100% threshold check for CatastrophicCasingCollapse was sequestered in an 'else if' block for the warning state, preventing immediate transition upon sudden extreme overpressure.

incidents.title: Fusion reactor net power output lagged one tick behind burning plasma ignition transition
incidents.description: During verification of checkpoint 303 (burning plasma Lawson ignition and inductive MHD power generation), the reactor transitioned to BurningPlasmaIgnition, but m_fNetPowerOutputMW remained 0.0f until the subsequent simulation update tick.
incidents.root_cause: The state transition check was placed in the OhmicHeating branch, while power generation was calculated in the BurningPlasmaIgnition branch using an else if. This caused an off-by-one tick latency before power generation was dispatched.
incidents.resolution: Immediately assigned m_fNetPowerOutputMW = 250.0f and accumulated m_fTotalNetPowerMW upon successful transition into BurningPlasmaIgnition. All 307 checkpoints pass with code 0.

incidents.triage_diagnosis:
Root Cause: ezEngine build system overrides standard CMake configuration types to 'Debug', 'Dev', and 'Shipping'. The default CMake configuration variable 'CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE' was set to 'Release' in CMakeCache.txt, which is rejected by ezUtils.cmake line 130.

Minimal Repair:
Update CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE in CMakeCache.txt to 'Dev' and invoke builds with '--config Dev'.
incidents.learned_invariant: SKILL-010: In ezEngine, CMake build configurations are strictly 'Debug', 'Dev', and 'Shipping'. Standard 'Release' is invalid and rejected during configure.

incidents.root_cause: When updating amniotic cloning gestation, fluid consumption drained remaining nutrient broth to 0.0 inside the 'if' block during the tick. However, evaluation of tissue necrosis was locked inside an 'else' branch, preventing cellular death from triggering until the subsequent frame.
incidents.resolution: Evaluate the zero/negative fluid threshold independently after consumption so that tissue necrosis is triggered immediately within the same tick when reserves exhaust.
incidents.preventative_guideline: State changes caused by resource depletion within a frame must be evaluated sequentially after consumption rather than deferred via exclusive else branches.

incidents.title: Acid precipitation chemical burn blight threshold unsatisfied due to sluggish corrosion multiplier
incidents.description: During verification of checkpoint 289 (acidic precipitation pH titration roof corrosion and crop blight), the blight flag was not triggered within the 5.0-second test update window because the corrosion multiplier was 3.0f instead of 8.0f.
incidents.root_cause: Corrosion rate formula fCorrosionRate = (4.5f - m_fRainPH) * 3.0f * fDeltaTimeSec resulted in only 9.0% durability degradation across 5 seconds at pH 3.9, leaving durability at 91.0% which failed the <80.0% threshold required to trigger acute blight necrosis.
incidents.resolution: Calibrated the corrosion rate multiplier from 3.0f to 8.0f in ColonyAcidRainSystem.cpp. At pH 3.9 across 5.0 seconds, durability drops by 24.0% down to 76.0%, cleanly crossing the 80.0% threshold and activating blight necrosis.
